theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_tangential_jacobian_hasDerivAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (B : ℝ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (P : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (Λ Λ' : ℝ → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (J : ℝ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → Λ 0 = 1 → (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-δ) δ, HasDerivAt Λ (Λ' t) t ∧ ‖Λ t‖ ≤ B ∧ ‖Λ' t‖ ≤ B ∧ ∀ v, ‖v‖ ≤ B * ‖Λ t v‖) → (∀ t, J t = Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin N ↦ inner ℝ (Λ t (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)))) (Λ t (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) + inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))))) → (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-δ) δ, 0 ≤ J t ∧ J t ≤ C ∧ ∃ d : ℝ, HasDerivAt J d t ∧ |d| ≤ C) ∧ HasDerivAt J (LinearMap.trace ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) ((Λ' 0).toLinearMap ∘ₗ P.starProjection.toLinearMap)) 0
